name: Sarah & Dave Miller
message: We saw your story on TikTok! Safe travels across Northern AZ. Grab a hot meal at the Route 66 diner when you roll into town!

name: Captain Dan
tier: Emergency Motel Room in a Storm
message: Been driving rig 18-wheelers for 22 years. The news lies about America—there's good folks at every exit. Keep your head up boys!

name: Maya Lin
message: Sending good vibes from LA! Nothing like a fresh shower after 8 hours standing on the highway ramp. Rooting for you Lee & Jake!

name: Tyler Vance
message: Black coffee & beef jerky energy fuel! Can't wait till you guys cross into New Mexico.

name: The Henderson Family
message: Ohio is waiting for you! We're showing our kids your daily updates to teach them about trust and open minds. Godspeed!

name: Chloe Bennett
message: Proof that human warmth is alive and well. Enjoy dinner on me when you hit the Gateway Arch!
